## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes (lint, typecheck, tests, build, ESM/CJS check)
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the behavior
- [ ] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if this changes a published package
- [ ] Updated docs if behavior or the public API changed
- [ ] No secrets, keys or personal data in code, tests or fixtures
